fields.overview_heading: A busy hospital facing operational challenges
fields.overview_content:
Vibrant Multi Speciality Hospital provides emergency, outpatient and surgical care across multiple departments. The hospital is NABH accredited and provides 24/7 emergency care.

As its operations grew, managing the administrative side became increasingly difficult. Billing, inventory, and patient workflows relied on manual processes and disconnected systems, leading to delays, errors and unnecessary administrative work. Staff were spending significant time on these activities, while leadership was hesitant to replace systems handling critical patient, inventory and billing data.
fields.problem_heading: Four operational challenges were slowing the hospital down
fields.problem_intro: The main challenge at Vibrant Hospital was not simply having different tools, but the manual work and fragmented processes required to manage information across departments.

problems.title: Separate Systems
problems.text: Different departments relied on separate systems for patient, billing and inventory activities. Information was spread across platforms, making coordination and visibility more difficult.

problems.title: Billing Took Days
problems.text: Staff had to enter billing information manually, verify details and collect data from different systems. This stretched billing cycles over days instead of hours and delayed the process.

problems.title: Limited Stock Visibility
problems.text: Staff lacked clear visibility into medical supplies, making it harder to maintain stock levels. Some supplies were over-ordered while others ran short, leading to wastage and unnecessary purchases.

problems.title: Heavy Administrative Work
problems.text: Staff spent considerable time on paperwork and routine administrative tasks. This increased their workload and reduced the time available for their core responsibilities.

fields.problem_outro: These challenges highlighted the need for a more connected way to manage daily hospital operations.
fields.decision_intro: Vibrant Hospital needed a more integrated way to manage its operations. The hospital chose Healthray HMS to bring billing, patient records and inventory workflows together in one system.
fields.quote_text: After switching to Healthray, we moved everything into one system. Now patient records, billing, pharmacy and inventory are all connected in one system.
fields.solution_intro: Healthray HMS addressed the operational challenges at Vibrant Hospital by reducing manual work across billing, patient management, inventory and routine task management.

solutions.title: Automated Billing
solutions.text: Billing processes were automated, reducing repetitive data entry and verification and helping staff complete billing faster.

solutions.title: Integrated Patient Management
solutions.text: Patient information was centralised in one system, reducing the need to search across platforms.

solutions.title: Inventory Management
solutions.text: Real-time inventory monitoring improved stock visibility, helping reduce wastage and unnecessary purchases.

solutions.title: Staff & Task Management
solutions.text: Staff and task management tools helped staff organise routine activities and reduce manual coordination.

fields.setup_heading: Go-live in under 2 weeks, with no downtime.
fields.setup_intro: Vibrant Hospital completed the transition to Healthray HMS without disrupting its operations.

steps.title: Data transferred

steps.title: System live

steps.title: Staff onboarded
steps.text: The simple interface helped staff get familiar with the system quickly.

fields.results_intro: Within a few months of implementing Healthray HMS, Vibrant Hospital saw measurable improvements across billing, administration and inventory management.

results.title: saved annually
results.text: Automation and better operational visibility helped reduce billing errors, inventory wastage and administrative work.

results.title: reduction in billing time
results.text: Automated charge capture helped shorten billing cycles and reduce the time required to complete billing.

results.title: reduction in manual errors
results.text: Standardised workflows and centralised data reduced manual errors across billing, records and coordination, reducing the need for rework.

results.title: Better inventory control
results.text: Real-time inventory monitoring helped the hospital maintain appropriate stock levels, reduce wastage and avoid unnecessary purchases.
